title: Clean Engram's project memories: retire spent entries, keep rules and Greg's words in force
outcome: Clean Engram's project memories: retire spent entries, keep rules and Greg's words in force
acceptance: Every Engram project memory read in full and judged: retained as a current rule or fact, revised to current content, or forgotten once spent, with anything still valid moved to its owning item or a keeper first.
Keys holding Greg's words are second-read in full by Engram::Fable before any is forgotten, and no word of his still in force is lost.
The pass reports its counts and exact keys retired on this item, without any store repair, filesystem write or change outside memories and work notes.

completion.summary: Read all 108 current heads; retire 19 spent memories, revise six keepers, retain 89 current entries with coordinator-reviewed Greg directions
